---
title: "Contour Plot"
subtitle: "Heatmap and contour marks visualize the density of penguin measurements, split by species."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Contour Plot](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/contours.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery. Setting the `fill` color to
`"species"` subdivides the data into three sets of densities.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
bandwidth <- param(bandwidth)
thresholds <- param(thresholds)

spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Contour Plot",
    description = paste(
      "Here `heatmap` and `contour` marks visualize the density of data points in a scatter",
      'plot of penguin measurments. Setting the `fill` color to `"species"` subdivides the',
      "data into three sets of densities."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "penguins", file = vg_data_url("penguins.parquet")) |>
  vg_params(bandwidth = 40, thresholds = 10) |>
  vg_vconcat(
    vg_hconcat(
      vg_slider(label = "Bandwidth (σ)", as = bandwidth, min = 1, max = 100),
      vg_slider(label = "Thresholds", as = thresholds, min = 2, max = 20)
    ),
    vg_mark_heatmap(
      data_from = "penguins", x = ~bill_length, y = ~bill_depth, fill = ~species, bandwidth = bandwidth
    ) |>
      vg_mark_contour(
        data_from = "penguins", x = ~bill_length, y = ~bill_depth,
        stroke = ~species, bandwidth = bandwidth, thresholds = thresholds
      ) |>
      vg_mark_dot(data_from = "penguins", x = ~bill_length, y = ~bill_depth, fill = "currentColor", r = 1) |>
      vg_plot(
        x_axis = "bottom", x_label_anchor = "center", y_axis = "right", y_label_anchor = "center",
        margins = list(top = 5, bottom = 30, left = 5, right = 50), width = 700, height = 480
      )
  )

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/contours.html) exactly, aside
from `data.penguins.file` (`vg_data_url()` vs. a relative path) and
object key order.
</details>
